description: This file defines an interface 'LimitOption' which specifies methods for pagination options (offset and count) in a search operation within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch' package. It appears to be part of a larger framework for searching or querying data with pagination support.

classes.name: LimitOption
classes.description: An interface that provides methods to retrieve pagination parameters (offset and count) and a string representation for a search limit option.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset value for pagination.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count or limit of results to retrieve.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the limit option in the format 'limit(offset,count)'.
